semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Labort Fine Chem Pvt Ltd provides high-quality laboratory chemicals essential for materials characterization and process development in the semiconductor industry.
summary: Labort Fine Chem Pvt Ltd specializes in manufacturing laboratory chemicals under the LABORT brand, with a focus on quality control using advanced analytical instruments. Their products are crucial for materials characterization and process development within the semiconductor industry.

regional_presence.India: Labort Fine Chem Pvt Ltd is located in South Gujarat near Surat, where it operates its manufacturing facility.
